text:
Naomi (Design): dropped a short concept: 'Rollback Safety Matrix' for the timeline. lightweight inline affordance that surfaces type (canary/release), confidence, and three rollback modes. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/rollback-safety-matrix

Evan (PM): quick ask: call out when metrics are partial and show recommended default mode (safe vs immediate).

Naomi (Design): default rules: if canary duration < 20m OR metrics incomplete -> recommend 'Safe (gradual)'; if error spike > 2x -> recommend 'Immediate'. UI shows recommended mode with a short rationale.

Rory (Eng): implementation notes: lazy-load metric snippets and cache. Safe rollback calls /api/rollback?safe=true; immediate calls /api/rollback?safe=false. server will return idempotency token. avoid fetching full diffs inline.

Tess (A11y): a11y nits: don't rely on color for confidence. include textual status and aria-live updates. panel must be keyboard openable and use role="dialog" when expanded. provide explicit aria-label for canary tag like "Canary: partial metrics".

Naomi (Design): added textual badge and aria example in notes: <button aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Open rollback options for v87: canary, partial metrics">Options</button>

Rory (Eng): engineering nit: animate expand with prefers-reduced-motion; use aria-busy while fetching details. sample css: .matrix { transition: max-height 220ms ease; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .matrix { transition: none; } }

Will (Support): support request: include 'View diagnostics' link in the confirm so agents can inspect logs before confirming. also prefer a two-step confirm on desktop.

Naomi (Design): mock updated: inline recommended mode + small 'Open' chevron -> slide-over with diagnostics, mode selector (Safe / Immediate / Custom), and confirm. Confirm copy: "Revert to this revision — routes traffic and switches model version. Runtime flags unchanged."

Evan (PM): let's A/B test two interaction patterns: A) inline matrix + slide-over detail (matrix_slide_v1) vs B) inline matrix + micro-popover confirm (matrix_popover_v1). track events: rollback_intent, rollback_confirm_safe, rollback_confirm_immediate, rollback_undo_5m, accidental_rollback_rate.

Tess (A11y): ensure the undo toast is keyboard-focusable and announced (aria-live="polite"). also check contrast on the warning icon at 14px.

Rory (Eng): noted. we'll lazy-load diagnostics on slide-over open, and return a compact SVG for sparklines. debounce confirm on server and include rollback_attempt_id in telemetry.

design-bot: snapshot created for design file 'rollback-safety-matrix' by Naomi at 1790123500

Naomi (Design): thanks all — i'll add aria snippets and experiment IDs to the handoff doc, and change CTA to "Revert and route traffic" per PM. scheduling a quick 10-min review after prototype. :thumbsup:
